Krypton collisional-radiative model for Hall thruster plumes

Abstract

A collisional-radiative model for krypton is presented, with the rates and cross sections needed to infer electron temperature from line ratios in thruster plumes. We measure electron temperature and density across the operating map of a laboratory thruster and fit a reduced kinetic model to the data.
